summary: ST-03 splits the secret roster into four size-tier children (WI-03a leaf; WI-03b/c/d stories), which after review splits decompose into 9 leaves, each with one focused tier behavior and at most three named changed subsystems (verified per frontmatter). Criteria are carried verbatim: the four direct children's union covers all four parent criteria (count, behavior, large, tests), and each promoted story's leaves cover all of its parent's criteria. Dependency order is sound: ST-03 -> ST-01/ST-02; WI-03c -> WI-03b (final AC-roster-behavior proof counts friendly species); WI-03d -> all three prior tiers (roster-wide count/test proofs); no ancestor/descendant dependencies or cycles, and dependencies on promoted stories correctly mean all their leaves. Final proof owners are named per criterion: WI-03d3 (AC-roster-count, AC-roster-tests incl. spoiler audit), WI-03c1b (AC-roster-behavior across tiers 1-3), WI-03d1 headless + WI-03d2 presentation (AC-roster-large floors). Tier floors are mutually satisfiable (min 17 species >= 15; min 4 large-scale >= 3). Splits preserve scope without dropping requirements or vague subsystem renames; every new directory is indexed in the task AGENTS.md; leaves stand alone with focused handoffs.
